title: Hardware and Software Installation and Support: Main Exam, 22 January 2021
department: Department of Information Technology / enterprise Computing
programme: Bachelor of Business Information Technology / bachelor of Science in Information Technology
unitTitle: Hardware and Software Installation and Support
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Define an operating system and exemplify five main functions of an operating system.
Name and discuss four main components of an operating system.
Give the system requirements for installing both Windows 8 and Mac OS X.
Differentiate between the following types of hard disks.
SATA
IDE
Basic
Dynamic
Define a driver as used in computing.
Discuss five different types of cables that are used in computers today.
Differentiate NTFS from FAT and state the advantages NTFS has over FAT.
Discuss the requirements for software installation over the network.
Highlight the procedure(s) that can be followed in resolving a hardware conflict in a computer.
Define disk formatting and differentiate quick format from a normal format.
Basic hard disks can be divided into several partitions. Name and briefly discuss the partitions that can be created in a basic disk.
Briefly highlight the steps required in order to check the speed of a computer's processor.
Define the following terms as used in computers.
Check disk
Disk cleanup
Disk defragmentation
CMOS
Front side bus
Access time
Explain the concept of virtual memory and how it is achieved in a computer.

Windows 7 supports dynamic storage, which is a standard that creates a single partition including the entire disk(s). Briefly discuss dynamic disks with examples and state the differences between the different types.
Electrostatic discharge (ESD) can cause permanent damage to electrical components. State three precautions one can take to prevent ESD damage while installing computer components.
Explain the role of RAM in improving the performance of a computer.
Explain the configuration that needs to be made in order to make two hard drives that are connected by the same data cable to the motherboard work properly.
Differentiate between primary and secondary storage as applied in computers, giving two examples in each case.
Describe the following types of computer ports.
USB port
AGP port
FireWire port
LPT port
Define hardware compatibility list in relation to operating system installation in a computer.
List and briefly discuss any three types of expansion slots found in computer systems.
